stories.title: Mother, 92, charged in 5-year-old son’s death 57 years after he died
stories.summary: Texas police say Harriet Hall, 92, has been charged with murder in the death of her 5-year-old son, Ronald, 57 years after he died.

stories.title: Man accused of killing co-worker at Airbnb with a gun he thought was unloaded
stories.summary: The suspect told police the shooting was a "freak accident."

stories.title: Rainbow Warriors rally back in gritty overtime win against Incarnate Word
stories.summary: Hawaiʻi erased a late deficit and defeated Incarnate Word 83-81 in overtime. Bol Dengdit scored 24 points.

stories.title: ‘The Epic Tale of Hiiaka’ musical production in previews after 13 years of development
stories.summary: Native Hawaiians were involved in creating the show, slated to open Dec. 5 at Ko Olina.

stories.title: Keawaula section of Kaena Point closes amid high surf, strong winds
stories.summary: The Keawaʻula section of Kaʻena Point State Park is closed amid large surf and strong wind advisories.

stories.title: Kalihi toddler’s lead test prompts evacuation of 19 residents
stories.summary: A toddler’s positive lead test prompted the evacuation of 19 Kalihi residents. Health officials found lead hazards at the property.

stories.title: County extends application deadlines for wildfire reconstruction, reimbursement programs
stories.summary: The County of Maui Office of Recovery has extended the application deadline for wildfire reconstruction and reimbursement programs.

stories.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade delay leaves Hawaii performers scrambling
stories.summary: Hawaiʻi performers are adjusting travel plans after the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed because of an approaching storm.

stories.title: Maui rally honors teen killed by impaired driver, urges sober driving
stories.summary: Hannah Brown's family and supporters rallied in Wailuku to urge sober driving during the holiday season.

stories.title: Stores open on Oahu for last-minute Thanksgiving shopping
stories.summary: Here’s what will be open across the islands.

stories.title: Island Lava Java reopens after receiving green placard during health inspection
stories.summary: The Hawaiʻi Department of Health issued the Kailua-Kona restaurant a green “pass” placard during a follow-up inspection Wednesday.

stories.title: Woman sentenced for DUI crash that killed teacher
stories.summary: A woman was sentenced to 20 years in prison after pleading guilty in a 2024 crash that killed a South Carolina teacher.
